select t.id, t.user_id as userId, if(vs.vacation_status=1,t.company_id,es.clinic_id) as orgId, t.vacation_id as vacationId, if(vs.vacation_status=1,t.start_time,ifnull(es.work_date,t.start_time)) as startDate, t.end_time as endDate, ls.start_time as startTime, ls.end_time as endTime, t.leave_reason as leaveReason, t.leave_picture as leavePicture, t.approval_now_people_id as approvalNowPeopleId, t.approval_criteria_id as approvalCriteriaId, t.approval_status as approvalStatus, vs.vacation_status as vacationStatus, ls.schedule_id as scheduleId from leave_info t left join vacation_set vs on t.vacation_id=vs.id left join leave_schedule ls on t.id=ls.leave_id left join employee_schedule es on es.id=ls.schedule_id
t.approval_status = 1 and vs.vacation_enable=1
and t.user_id in
#{item}
and (DATE_FORMAT(t.start_time,'%Y-%m-%d') <= DATE_FORMAT(#{date},'%Y-%m-%d') and DATE_FORMAT(t.end_time,'%Y-%m-%d') >= DATE_FORMAT(#{date},'%Y-%m-%d') or DATE_FORMAT(es.work_date,'%Y-%m-%d') = DATE_FORMAT(#{date},'%Y-%m-%d'))
order by t.start_time asc

select id, user_id , vacation_id , start_time , end_time , leave_reason , leave_picture , approval_criteria_id , approval_status from leave_info
approval_status in(0,1)
and user_id = #{userId}
order by start_time asc

select als.* from approval_criteria ac left JOIN approval_level_set als on als.approval_criteria_id = ac.id where ac.start_day < IF(TIMESTAMPDIFF(day,#{startTime},#{endTime})=0,1,TIMESTAMPDIFF(day,#{startTime},DATE_ADD(#{endTime}, INTERVAL '1' DAY))) and IFNULL(ac.end_day,9999)>=TIMESTAMPDIFF(day,#{startTime},DATE_ADD(#{endTime}, INTERVAL '1' DAY))

SELECT count(*) FROM leave_info WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND DATE_FORMAT(start_time,'%Y-%m-%d') <= DATE_FORMAT(#{startTime}, '%Y-%m-%d') AND DATE_FORMAT(end_time,'%Y-%m-%d') >= DATE_FORMAT(#{startTime}, '%Y-%m-%d') AND approval_status IN (0, 1)

select sum(num) from (SELECT count(*) num FROM field_info WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND DATE_FORMAT(start_time,'%Y-%m-%d') <= DATE_FORMAT(#{endTime}, '%Y-%m-%d') AND DATE_FORMAT(start_time,'%Y-%m-%d') >= DATE_FORMAT(#{startTime}, '%Y-%m-%d') AND approval_status IN (0, 1) union SELECT count(*) num FROM work_overtime_info WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND DATE_FORMAT(work_date,'%Y-%m-%d') <= DATE_FORMAT(#{endTime}, '%Y-%m-%d') AND DATE_FORMAT(work_date,'%Y-%m-%d') >= DATE_FORMAT(#{startTime}, '%Y-%m-%d') AND approval_status IN (0, 1)) a

SELECT ai.leave_id leaveId, ap.user_id userId, als.approval_priority approvalPriority, ai.approval_status approvalStatus, ai.crt_time crtTime, ai.upd_time updTime FROM approval_info ai LEFT JOIN approval_people ap ON ai.approval_people_id = ap.id LEFT JOIN approval_level_set als ON ap.approval_level_id = als.id WHERE ai.leave_id = #{id} ORDER BY als.approval_priority desc

SELECT li.id AS id, li.user_id AS userId, vs.vacation_name AS vacationName, vs.vacation_status AS vacationStatus, li.crt_time AS crtTime, li.start_time AS startTime, li.end_time AS endTime, IFNULL( sum( TIMESTAMPDIFF( MINUTE, ls.start_time, ls.end_time ) ), TIMESTAMPDIFF( MINUTE, li.start_time, DATE_ADD(li.end_time, INTERVAL '1' DAY) ) / 3 ) AS leaveTime, li.approval_status AS approvalStatus, ap.user_id AS uid FROM leave_info li LEFT JOIN approval_people ap on li.approval_now_people_id = ap.id LEFT JOIN approval_info ai ON ai.leave_id = li.id and ai.approval_people_id = ap.id LEFT JOIN leave_schedule ls on ls.leave_id = li.id LEFT JOIN vacation_set vs on li.vacation_id = vs.id where ap.user_id = #{userId} and li.approval_status = 0 group BY li.id order by li.crt_time desc

SELECT li.id AS id, li.user_id AS userId, vs.vacation_name AS vacationName, vs.vacation_status AS vacationStatus, li.crt_time AS crtTime, li.start_time AS startTime, li.end_time AS endTime, IFNULL( sum( TIMESTAMPDIFF( MINUTE, ls.start_time, ls.end_time ) ), TIMESTAMPDIFF( MINUTE, li.start_time, DATE_ADD(li.end_time, INTERVAL '1' DAY) ) / 3 ) AS leaveTime, li.approval_status AS approvalStatus FROM leave_info li LEFT JOIN approval_info ai ON ai.leave_id = li.id LEFT JOIN approval_people ap on ai.approval_people_id = ap.id LEFT JOIN approval_level_set als on ap.approval_level_id = als.id LEFT JOIN leave_schedule ls on ls.leave_id = li.id LEFT JOIN vacation_set vs on li.vacation_id = vs.id where ai.approval_status in (2,1) and ap.user_id = #{userId} group BY ai.leave_id order by li.crt_time desc
